caption:
the 9-week plan didn't change. the calendar got smarter

#comeback #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
Week one of the
9-week running plan

Run one minute,
walk ninety seconds

You know the one

Three mornings a week

It put them on mine

Week one shows up

Three hearts a week,
nine weeks out

A bad night moves the run

It never rewrites the plan

slides.heading: Runs around your sleep
slides.body: SOMA schedules the beginner 5K block you chose and shifts sessions when recovery says so — the plan stays yours
